title: Total seconds
prompt: A time is given as minutes and seconds. Return the total number of seconds.
signature: func solve(minutes: int, seconds: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(minutes: int, seconds: int) -> int:
	return seconds
hint: Convert the minutes first, then add the leftover seconds.
solution:
func solve(minutes: int, seconds: int) -> int:
	return minutes * 60 + seconds
